name: The or no article? I like music / the music in this film
subtitle: I like music. The music in this film is great. Use the for a specific thing that we both know, and no article for things in general: music, cats, coffee. A few fixed phrases have no article too: go to work, at home, by bus.
briefHtml:
"I like music. The music in this film is great." Why is there no article in the first sentence?

  • —No article: things in general (plural and uncountable nouns).
  • a/anNew, one of many (singular countable nouns).
  • theSpecific: we both know which one.
source: icanspeak Spanish original English text (grammar-a2 run, 2026-10-29)

scenes.label: in general
scenes.why: Coffee in general, any coffee. Uncountable and general: no article.

scenes.label: one, new
scenes.why: One cup, a singular countable thing: a.

scenes.label: specific
scenes.sayHtml: The coffee in this café is great.
scenes.why: We both know which coffee: the one in this café. Use the.

concept.exampleHtml: I love coffee. Can I have a coffee, please? The coffee in this café is great.

qa.html:
the: specific, we both know which one.
the sun, the music in this film
a / an: one, singular and countable.
a cat, an apple
no article: in general, with plural and uncountable nouns.
Cats are clever. I like music.

Plural nouns and uncountable nouns in general have no article.
I like music. Cats are clever. Coffee is expensive. Life is hard.
Not ✗ The cats are clever. (if you mean all cats)

Use the when both people know which one: it is mentioned before, or it is clear from the situation.
The music in this film is great.
Please close the door.
I've got a cat. The cat is black.

Use the for things where there is only one for everybody.
the sun, the moon, the sea, the sky, the world
Also places in town: the cinema, the bank, the station, the shops

Learn these as a whole. They have no article.
go to work, go to school, go home, be at home, in bed
by bus, by car, by train, on foot
have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner
on Monday, in July, at night

Sports, languages, subjects and most countries and cities: no article.
I play football. She speaks Spanish. He lives in France.
A few countries have the:
the UK, the USA, the Netherlands
✗ The life is hard. → ✓ Life is hard. · ✗ I go to the work by the bus. → ✓ I go to work by bus. · ✗ She lives in UK. → ✓ She lives in the UK.

concept.noteHtml: Musical instruments take the: She plays the piano. He plays the guitar. Sports do not: I play tennis. School, hospital, university have no article when we think of the activity: She is at school. He is in hospital. With the we mean the building: I'm going to the school for a meeting. The forms a, an, the are explained at Articles. Plural and uncountable nouns are in Plural nouns and Countable and uncountable nouns.

items: 1. One specific thing, and we both know which? → the
2. One of many, singular and countable? → a / an
3. Things in general, plural or uncountable? → no article
4. A fixed phrase (go to work, at home, by bus)? → learn it as a whole
I like music. → music in general
I'm listening to a song. → one song, new
The song is great. → this song, we both know it
Same with: coffee · a coffee (one cup) · the coffee (this one)

exercises.title: the, a/an or no article? Choose.
exercises.hint: Specific, we both know which? → the. One, singular? → a/an. In general, a fixed phrase or a country? → no article (—).
exercises.hintHtml: theSpecific: we both know which one.a/anOne, singular and countable.—In general, a fixed phrase, a name.

items.prompt: Most people like ___ chocolate.
items.why: Chocolate in general ("most people"): no article.

items.prompt: I've got ___ dog and two cats.
items.why: One dog, a singular countable noun: a.

items.prompt: ___ music in this film is great.
items.why: The music in one specific film: the.

items.prompt: I think ___ cats are clever animals.
items.why: Cats in general, plural: no article.

items.prompt: Please close ___ door. It's cold in here.
items.why: We both know which door: the.

items.prompt: Look at ___ sun! It's very bright.
items.why: There is only one sun: the.

items.prompt: I go to ___ work by bus.
items.why: A fixed phrase: go to work, with no article.

items.prompt: My sister is ___ engineer. She likes her job.
items.why: A job is a singular countable noun: an (engineer starts with a vowel sound).

items.prompt: My cousin lives in ___ UK.
items.why: A few countries need the: the UK, the USA, the Netherlands.

items.prompt: We have ___ breakfast at eight.
items.why: Meals: have breakfast, with no article.

exercises.title: Countries and places: the or no the?
exercises.hint: Most countries and cities have no article. A few countries (the UK, the USA, the Netherlands) take the. Some places in town take the (the cinema).

items.prompt: My cousin lives in ___ Spain.
items.why: Most countries have no article: in Spain.
